python3 << 'EOF'
# Treasury bond weekly yields for 1970
feb_first = 6.71   # Feb 6, 1970
apr_last = 6.69    # Apr 24, 1970
jul_first = 6.73   # July 3, 1970
sep_last = 6.52    # Sept 25, 1970

# Calculate absolute percentage change from first week of Feb to last week of Apr
# Formula: |(new - old) / old| * 100
change_feb_apr = abs((apr_last - feb_first) / feb_first) * 100
print(f"Feb to Apr absolute percentage change: {change_feb_apr:.4f}%")

# Calculate absolute percentage change from first week of July to last week of Sep
change_jul_sep = abs((sep_last - jul_first) / jul_first) * 100
print(f"July to September absolute percentage change: {change_jul_sep:.4f}%")

# Calculate ratio
ratio = change_feb_apr / change_jul_sep
print(f"Ratio: {ratio:.4f}")

# Round to one decimal place
ratio_rounded = round(ratio, 1)
print(f"Ratio (rounded to 1 decimal place): {ratio_rounded}")
EOF
